privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.bodyHtml:
Privacy policy

Privacy Policy

Tottoms LLC  •  Last updated: June 7th, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Tottoms LLC (“Tottoms,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you visit tottoms.com, use our services, attend our events, or make a purchase from us (collectively, the “Services”). “You” means any individual whose information we collect, including customers, event participants, and website visitors.

Please read this policy carefully. By using the Services, you agree to the practices described here. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

1. Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

When you interact with us, you may provide:

  • Name, email address, phone number, and mailing address

  • Billing and shipping information for purchases

  • Account credentials (username and password)

  • Event waiver information, including date of birth and emergency contact details

  • Customer support communications

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our site, we automatically collect:

  • Device type, browser, and operating system

  • IP address and general location

  • Pages visited, time spent, and referring URLs

  • Cookie and pixel data (see Section 5)

Information from Third Parties

We may receive information from payment processors (e.g., Shopify Payments), advertising partners, and analytics providers. Any information received from third parties is handled in accordance with this policy.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process orders, payments, and returns

  • Manage your account and provide customer support

  • Send transactional communications (order confirmations, shipping updates)

  • Operate event check-in, liability waivers, and ride queue management

  • Send SMS queue notifications when you opt in at an event (see Section 4)

  • Send marketing emails and promotions (you may opt out at any time)

  • Detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized activity

  • Improve our website, products, and services through analytics

  • Comply with applicable laws and enforce our terms


3. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with:

  • Service providers who help us operate the business (e.g., payment processors, shipping carriers, cloud hosting, email platforms)

  • Shopify, as our e-commerce platform provider, subject to their privacy policy

  • Business and marketing partners with your consent

  • Law enforcement or government agencies when required by law or to protect rights

  • Acquirers or successors in the event of a merger, sale, or restructuring


4. SMS Messaging

We send SMS text messages for the following purposes:

  • Queue notifications: When you provide your phone number at a Tottoms event check-in kiosk and consent to receive SMS, we will send a confirmation when you join the queue and a notification when it is your turn to ride.

  • Transactional updates: Order confirmations, shipping notifications, or other account-related messages.

Opt-in: By providing your phone number and checking the consent box on our event waiver or checkout, you agree to receive these messages. Consent is not a condition of purchase.

Opt-out: Reply STOP to any message at any time to unsubscribe. Reply HELP for assistance. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies.

We do not share your phone number with third parties for their marketing purposes.

5. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies to improve site performance, remember your preferences, and analyze traffic. Third-party tools (such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel) may also set cookies when you visit our site.

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may limit some functionality of the site. For details on how Shopify uses cookies, see shopify.com/legal/cookies.

We participate in interest-based advertising. You may opt out through the Digital Advertising Alliance at optout.aboutads.info.

6. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When information is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it.

7. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you

  • Correct inaccurate information

  • Request deletion of your information

  • Opt out of the sale or sharing of your information (we do not sell personal data)

  • Withdraw consent where we rely on consent to process your data

  • Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority


To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details in Section 10. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law and may need to verify your identity before fulfilling your request.

Marketing emails: You may unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email we send. We may still send non-promotional messages such as order updates.

8. Children’s Privacy

Our Services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with their information, please contact us and we will delete it promptly. Event participants under 18 must have a parent or guardian complete the event waiver on their behalf.

9. Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure. Please use secure channels when communicating sensitive information and keep your account credentials confidential.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. When we do, we will update the “Last updated” date at the top and post the revised policy on our site. Continued use of the Services after any update constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

11. Contact Us

For questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us:

Tottoms LLC

New Port Richey, FL

Email: support@tottoms.com

Phone: 727-494-4652

Website: tottoms.com

refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.bodyHtml:
Refund policy

Refund Policy

We have a 7-day return policy, which means you have 7 days after receiving your item to request a return.

To be eligible for a return, the item must be in the same condition that you received it. It must be unused, undamaged, and returned in its original packaging. You will also need to provide a receipt or proof of purchase.

To start a return, please contact us at support@tottoms.com.

If your return is accepted, we will send you the next steps and any return instructions.

Damages and Issues

Please inspect your order as soon as it arrives. If your item is defective, damaged, or if you received the wrong item, please contact us immediately at support@tottoms.com so we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return, we will notify you whether the refund has been approved.

If approved, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 10 business days. Please keep in mind that your bank or credit card company may take additional time to process and post the refund.

If more than 15 business days have passed since your refund was approved, please contact us at support@tottoms.com.
